title: docs(pm-dispatch): rest-channel records the measured relay automerge_disable and pr_draft strokes
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao87ykfhrgVAbQefAY1bBg2q)_

Fixes #27848

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`rest-channel.md` 反向两 op 那句「未实调」换成三行实测读数(反向 F 实调通过、行即回读、出队未实测),并把只剩一个指针的「第三桶」小节折进队列读法的指针行;80 → 79 行,每行 ≤120 字节。
- 为什么改:复核 FAIL 时 `automerge_disable`/`pr_draft` 已是席位的强制动作,席位读到「未实调」无法判断它要发的 op 是否可靠;中继日志里两 op 已于 2026-10-25 在一张已挂臂未入队的 PR 上走通。
- 风险与回滚:只改规则文本,无门禁、无代码、无发布面;回滚 = revert 本提交。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md` 第 57–60 行(改句 + 三行新读数),再看第 72 行(折并的指针)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 绿;打开 fleet-write run 40164374680 的日志,对照 `✓ action 1 automerge_disable … auto-merge off · not in the merge queue` 与 `✓ action 2 pr_draft … draft` 两行。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`.claude/**`),席位契约复审 PASS 后请 os-zhuang 批准,席位落地。

## What changes

One file: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md` (80 → 79 lines, ceiling 80; every touched line ≤ 120 bytes).

- The reverse-ops clause on the auto-merge line (「反向两 op 未实调」) now ends 「反向实调如下」 and is followed by three rule lines:
  1. `✓ 反向 F = automerge_disable 再 pr_draft` — measured on an armed, unqueued pull; both ops answered HTTP 200; the approval on the pull was not dismissed.
  2. The row is the read-back: `autoMergeRequest` null and `isDraft` true are the landed states; an answer still armed or still ready is a FAILED action (exit 5) that stops the stroke.
  3. Dequeue not measured: the one `pr_draft` sent to a queued pull answered no `pullRequest` (row FAILED, exit 5) while the conversion landed and the pull kept its queue place; queue membership is read from the timeline, not from the row.
- Paid for by deleting the three-line `第三桶 —— git 零配额等价物` section (heading, blank line, one pointer line) and carrying its pointer into the existing queue-reading pointer line (「①② 与 git 零配额四条的拼写与边界住 platform-readings.md」). The four readings it pointed at live in `platform-readings.md` (quota-starvation section ①–④), so no rule is lost.
- `platform-readings.md` is NOT touched: the order allows that edit only on a measured dequeue, and none was observed.

The rules-only convention of this file (no provenance dates, no incident narrative) keeps the run ids out of the rule text; they are recorded here.

## Why

PR #27845 made `automerge_disable` and `pr_draft` the mandatory disarm on a contract-review FAIL. A seat reading 「未实调」 could not tell whether the ops it must send are known to work.

## Tests

No code changed; the gates below are the test surface.

<details><summary>Measured strokes (evidence for the three lines)</summary>

**The clean stroke, both ops — 2026-10-25.** fleet-write run **40164374680** (job 121082282055, request `fw-20261025T050717Z-17ca1b`, head f9a1e93f43) sent `[{"op":"automerge_disable","pull":25745},{"op":"pr_draft","pull":25745}]`. Log rows:

```text
✓ action 1 automerge_disable: POST /graphql disablePullRequestAutoMerge -> HTTP 200 · #25745 · auto-merge off · not in the merge queue · its base has a merge queue
✓ action 2 pr_draft: POST /graphql convertPullRequestToDraft -> HTTP 200 · #25745 · draft
fleet-write/execute: ✓ 2 request(s) landed, every action done.
```

Those rows are the mutation answers judged by `PR_LANDED_STATE` (`ops.mjs`): `autoMergeRequest: null`, `isInMergeQueue: false`, `isMergeQueueEnabled: true`, then `isDraft: true`. PR #25745's timeline (`GET /issues/25745/timeline`, 105 events) confirms the stored state: `auto_merge_enabled` by os-zhuang at 05:06:41Z, then `auto_merge_disabled` (05:07:45Z) and `convert_to_draft` (05:07:48Z), both by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; the approving review 5641652106 carries no `review_dismissed` event; the PR has **no** `added_to_merge_queue` event at any point (it was armed on a red battery, never queued), so a dequeue is not measured here.

**A `pr_draft` on a queued pull — 2026-10-24.** Run **40042854158** (job 120717690554, request `fw-20261024T000127Z-f103d0`): `[{"op":"pr_draft","pull":25550}]` →

```text
✗ action 1 pr_draft: POST /graphql convertPullRequestToDraft -> GraphQL: the answer carries no pullRequest
fleet-write/execute: ✗ stopped at action 1 (pr_draft); 0 later action(s) NOT attempted.
Process completed with exit code 5.
```

PR #25550's timeline: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-10-23T23:55:28Z; `convert_to_draft` by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 2026-10-24T00:01:34Z (so the conversion landed although the row read FAILED); `ready_for_review` 00:09:55Z; the only `removed_from_merge_queue` is 00:27:36Z by `github-merge-queue[bot]`, followed one second later by `merged`. No dequeue: the queued pull kept its place through draft and re-ready and merged from the queue. This is the third observation of the reading already on `platform-readings.md` line 42 (2026-08-08, 09-29); not added there, see Acceptance notes.

**A `pr_draft` after a queue ejection — 2026-10-27.** Run **40434252633** (job 121959027306, request `fw-20261027T014328Z-71eed1`): `pr_draft` on #26343 answered `HTTP 200 · #26343 · draft` after the queue had already ejected the pull (`removed_from_merge_queue` 01:43:37Z by `github-merge-queue[bot]`, `convert_to_draft` 01:44:07Z). Not a dequeue either; cited as the newer `pr_draft` reading.

**Search method.** PR timelines of the three pulls named in the seat's records, and `GET /actions/workflows/fleet-write.yml/runs?created=…` on the minute windows around each timeline event (12, 3 and 4 runs respectively), each candidate's job log read in full. Not an exhaustive scan of every fleet-write run since 2026-10-24 (hundreds per hour), so a later stroke carrying `automerge_disable` may exist unrecorded; the 2026-10-25 run is the only one found that sends it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `platform-readings.md` line 42 (「已入队者 2026-08-08、09-29 照合」) gained a third observation on 2026-10-24 (PR #25550). Not added: the dispatch order limits `platform-readings.md` edits to a measured dequeue. Carrier: skills seat 1.
- The seat's lead dated the revert 2026-10-26; the stroke is 2026-10-25 05:07Z (timeline + run log). Correction only, no card.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md` prints "no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)", while the FRAME and the Claim call the tier MANDATORY for this surface. The run was on claude-fable-5-1 either way; noted for the seat, not filed (gate-vocabulary observation, no wrong answer to a public door).
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` row for this file stays at 80 with the file at 79 lines. The convention lowers the row to the landed count, but `scripts/pm/` is outside this card's declared file surface; the seat may fold the lowering into its next touch of the ratchet table.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` has no `evals/` directory, so there is no skill evals check to run for this surface.

## Verification

Run at head f194f8f2 in a fresh linked worktree of this repository after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` (under `os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0, 75 s).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 17 families for the one changed path. Every line run with stdin from /dev/null, exit code captured before any pipe:

- Line widths: `awk 'length($0) > 120'` over the file prints nothing; touched lines are 114 / 113 / 109 / 113 / 120 bytes.
- Changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing (fast-track class) → `skip-changeset`, declared on the `pr_create` stroke.
- Relay writes: 1 (`pr_create`, this PR) + 1 (`os-dev-report` comment on #27848). MCP GitHub write calls: 0.
